## Checklist

### Visual Sweet Spot Check

- [ ] Text readable at lens center without squinting
- [ ] No visible chromatic aberration at reading distance
- [ ] Refresh fluid (no reprojection artifacts / dropped frames)

### Head-tracking Latency

- [ ] Motion-to-photon feels indistinguishable from native apps (no visible lag on fast head turns)
- [ ] Jitter: none at rest, no drift over a 5-minute idle

### Ergonomic Readability

- [ ] Comfortable for a planned 30-min session (no strain reported)
- [ ] UI targets comfortable for generic hand/controller input, if applicable
